<div class="card-body">
'''K'lor'slug''' is a [[Light]] [[Creature]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">クロア・スラッグ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">場の自分の側に配備する。戦闘の際、１フォース消費して、合計能力値を１減らすごとに、合計戦力に＋１できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-53o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ノーハオンの沼に住む、猛毒を持つ怪物のデジャリックホログラム。鋭い嗅覚と視覚を持つ猛獣。卵生で、数百もの肉食の幼虫が誕生する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' K'lor'slug.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. In battle, you may use 1 Force and add 1 to total power for each point by which you reduce total ability.

'''Lore:''' A dejarik hologram of a highly venomous monster that lives in the swamps of Noe'ha'on. It has keen senses of smell and sight. It lays eggs that produce hundreds of carnivorous young.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[K'lor'slug]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
